samples.name: character-rabbit-frame-1
samples.prompt: Single brown wild hare game sprite, facing RIGHT, for a cozy top-down medieval village. Match minimal chunky pixel art of supplied Kenney Tiny Town/Tiny Farm sheets. Transparent 16x16 logical canvas enlarged with nearest neighbor: each logical pixel is a big solid square, at most 16 squares across entire canvas. Hare body about 9 logical pixels long, long ears, small white tail on LEFT rump, one dark brown square eye, tan belly, two flat brown shades maximum. No texture, gradients, antialiasing, ground, shadows, text or extra subjects. Keep whole animal inside canvas. Sitting on haunches, feet at bottom row. Upright ears.
